target.confidence: one-sided95% exact Clopper-Pearson; pointwise, not familywise

unit: one separate full known BPSK frame =16 known symbols =8192 complex full-field measurement components; QR retains512 complex sufficient components
training: Sylvester Hadamard rows in natural order multiplied elementwise by existing seed20261030 BPSK pilot; first row is existing pilot; repeated cycles beyond16 do not increase rank
distribution: Nominal channel uniform among16 selected before drift; each active drift independently uniform symmetric in listed degrees/degrees/mm. Independent sessions, fixed within entire training+5data-frame session.
noise: full8192 complex detector components iid circular Gaussian; each quadrature sigma=sqrt(P_ref*10^(-SNR/10)/2); P_ref=mean over16 nominal channels sum(abs(A)^2)/(8192), i.e. expected unit-energy randomBPSK output power per complex component. Sigma fixed across inputs/budgets; no signal renormalization.
energy: main each complete BPSK frame norm2=1; each symbol1/16; total incident norm F+K. Fixed-total counterpart sets amplitude sqrt((F+1)/(F+K)), fixed detector noise unchanged. Unit is normalized incident field norm, not measured joule.
phase_gain: physical g=1 held fixed; receiver jointly profiles unknown common complex gain forK>0; K0 uses known amplitude and phase reference g=amplitude

L.prior: preconfigured nominal channel shared before actual drift; no exact parameter access

E1.prior: public16 nominal channel neighborhoods, no selected channel
E1.selection: public training residual; decode top endpoints and prefer CRC-valid packet; K0 enumerate all16 public channels using CRC, never truth

E2.prior: identical L nominal, observation, algorithm, seed and budget; independent rerun must agree

ideal.use: upper bound diagnostic only; carrier amplitude known

no_calibration.gain: from available pilots forK>0, otherwise known amplitude; no parameter fitting

linear.known_pairs: only actual public full training frames
linear.method: real-valued ridge decoder X(Yr^T Yr+lambda I)^-1 Yr^T
linear.K0: NOT_APPLICABLE; no labelled pair, not counted as failed attack

adaptive.fit: firstK-1 frames; last frame withheld from fit as prediction check
adaptive.stop: residual energy <= 2*1024*sigma^2 + 1e-10*observed_validation_energy; projected512complex domain; frozen threshold, not tuned on tests
adaptive.after_stop: refit allK for data; final K16 if never passes is forced_max, not successful_stop
adaptive.feedback: one public STOP/CONTINUE bit after each testedstage; all addedframes and feedback count, E1/E2 observe K and feedback
adaptive.actual_protocol: sequential requests to sender; receiver never receives unsent future frames; simulated potential noise is paired by index

selection: amongtestedK,validation L whole80-bitpacket+CRC success>=.99; smallestcandidate. Intermediateintegerbudgets may be tested only in thatcell using samevalidation IDs, labelled selection; confirmation independent. No confirmation when no candidate.
primary_confirmation: only joint60; test selected B, default A(K1), and frozen adaptive C on299 fixedindependentsessions; report pointwise CI, never pool correlated frames.
costs: all coarse/optimizer/failed forward model evaluations and16-symbol-equivalent propagations; shared QR/Gram preprocessing separately; actual timings include contexts, search and decode, E2 repeats.
limits: frozen approximate three-layer model, no newFDTD
preconfigured channel advantage is prior information, not user identity
nearcardinal coarse-grid topology constant, angle sensitivity here isJones response; not subdegree physical validation
public_copy_notice: Public protocol excerpt. The full frozen protocol and private seeds are retained locally for audit, and were not supplied to receiver interfaces.
